articles.title: Cyclist protest delays province from starting bike lane removal in Etobicoke
articles.summary: Cyclists in Toronto delayed the province's scheduled removal of a portion of the Bloor Street W. bike lane in Etobicoke by holding a sit-in protest that stopped scheduled construction from starting until Wednesday afternoon.

articles.title: Kawhi Leonard fits right in with new Raptors teammates as Toronto romps past Knicks
articles.summary: As far as Kawhi Leonard was concerned, his first game with his new Toronto Raptors teammates felt like a seamless fit. Leonard drew the loudest cheers of the night — especially when he scored each of his game-high 21 points — in his re-debut for the Raptors as Toronto rolled past the New York Knicks 148-98 on Tuesday.
